title: News reviewed: 9 item(s)
body:
- licensing agreements/commercial.md changed (doc:licensing/agreements/commercial.md): no effect here: Reaches this repo only through `tend baseline render --write` (LICENSE.md, LICENSES/), left to the user because that render also takes the repo's hook entries out of .claude/settings.local.json
- licensing combos.toml changed (doc:licensing/combos.toml): no effect here: Same render as the other licensing texts; the library combo is unchanged in .tend/extends.toml
- licensing contributing.md changed (doc:licensing/contributing.md): no effect here: Reaches this repo only through the user's `tend baseline render --write`
- licensing texts/commercial.md changed (doc:licensing/texts/commercial.md): no effect here: LICENSES/LicenseRef-Commercial-1.0.txt is refreshed by the user's `tend baseline render --write`
- licensing texts/open-project-exception.md changed (doc:licensing/texts/open-project-exception.md): no effect here: LICENSES/AdditionRef-Open-Project-Exception-1.0.txt is refreshed by the user's `tend baseline render --write`
- licensing texts/royalty-free.md changed (doc:licensing/texts/royalty-free.md): no effect here: LICENSES/LicenseRef-Royalty-Free-1.0.txt is refreshed by the user's `tend baseline render --write`
- Jacquard finished milestone M4 Input bumps (progress:Jacquard/milestone:M4 Input bumps): no effect here: Jacquard's input-bump milestone changes nothing this repo declares; its deploys read nix#configurations, whose export version is unchanged
- Tend finished milestones 2 (Status system to Control station) (progress:Tend/milestone:Control station): no effect here: Tend's own milestones; nothing here waits on them (the hook dispatcher this repo waits on is graft 01a19407-a869, still open)
- vg-paradigms released 2026.10.11 (progress:vg-paradigms/release:2026.10.11): a design change proposed: Its rule ci.contributors-only is carried out here: CI workflow deleted, checks moved to nix/scripts/check.sh (this session's proposal); the rendered AGENTS.md picks up the rest at the user's render
